name: Gooey Navbar
description: A liquid navigation bar: the active item sits in a solid pill, and a gap opens around whichever item you hover or select while the two pills bend into a curved neck, so the bar reads as a single drop of liquid being stretched.
interactionNotes: Hovering or selecting an item opens a gap around it and the neighbouring pills reach towards each other with a curved neck. The gaps are spring driven, so they overshoot a little and settle back. Every item is a real link: a click calls `onSelect` and, by default, prevents the browser from following `href`. Tab reaches each item and shows a focus outline. With `prefers-reduced-motion`, the gaps jump straight to their place instead of springing.

props.name: items
props.description: The links. Each item has a `label`, a `link` and an optional fixed `width`; without a width the pill measures the rendered label plus `paddingX`.

props.name: defaultActiveIndex
props.description: Which item starts selected when the bar keeps its own state.

props.name: activeIndex
props.description: Controlled selection; pass it with `onSelect` to own the state yourself.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Runs on every click with the index and the item.

props.name: pillColor
props.description: Fill of the pills and of the liquid neck between them.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Label color, and the color of the active dot.

props.name: hoverTextColor
props.description: Label color of the item under the pointer.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Label size, pixels; the pill height follows it together with `paddingY`.

props.name: paddingX
props.description: Horizontal padding inside each pill; it is part of the measured width.

props.name: paddingY
props.description: Vertical padding; the pill height is `fontSize` plus twice this.

props.name: cornerRadius
props.description: Corner radius of the pills, clamped to half the pill height.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between the pills at rest.

props.name: neighborPush
props.description: How far the gap opens around the hovered or active item, pixels.

props.name: anchorEdge
props.description: Which edge stays put while the gaps push the bar wider. It is logical, so `start` means the right edge in a right-to-left page.

props.name: neckRatio
props.description: Thickness of the liquid neck as a fraction of the pill height.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Spring stiffness of the gaps; higher snaps faster.

props.name: damping
props.description: Spring damping; lower lets the gaps overshoot more.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class for the root box.

tips: Keep the labels short: each pill measures the rendered label plus `paddingX`, so a very long one makes a very wide pill.
The labels are measured again once the web font finishes loading, which keeps the pills aligned when the project uses a custom Persian font.
Use `start` and `end` for `anchorEdge`, not left and right: the geometry is mirrored for right-to-left, so `start` pins the bar to the right edge.
Pass `activeIndex` with `onSelect` to control the selection; without them the bar remembers the last click itself.
Clicks call `preventDefault()`, so handle the destination in `onSelect` or swap the anchor for your router's link.
Hover needs a real pointer; on touch the pill and its dot still mark the active item, but the liquid neck stays away.
